items.title: File Widerspruch against the Aufhebungsbescheid
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: Document dated Wed 08.07.2026, presumed posted same day. Bekanntgabefiktion for social-administrative acts (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): deemed received 3 days after posting = 11.07.2026 (Saturday). Since the third day falls on a Saturday, by settled practice (analogous to § 122 Abs. 2 AO / no postal delivery on weekends) the deemed access shifts to the next working day = Monday 13.07.2026. One-month Widerspruch period per § 84 SGG in conjunction with §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (13.07.2026) is not counted; the period runs from 14.07.2026 and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering day, i.e. 13.08.2026 (Thursday, no NRW holiday, no shift needed).
